remarks: Welcome to 7 Seir Hill Rd, Unit 13 - A bright and spacious 2BR/2.5BA townhouse in a well-maintained Norwalk community. This move-in-ready home offers 1,000+ sq. ft. with an open floor plan and updated finishes throughout including brand-new flooring. The kitchen features granite countertops, ample cabinetry and newer stainless steel appliances. A convenient half bath is located on the main level. Upstairs are two oversized bedrooms, each with deep closets, ceiling fans, and private full baths-plenty of room for king beds. A brand new in-unit washer/dryer completes the package.  This unit includes one assigned parking space (#55-2) plus ample visitor parking. Enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds, walking paths, and a pet-friendly setting (one dog or cat allowed). The location is a commuter's dream-just steps to the Merritt 7 Metro-North station with express service to NYC, and close to I-95, Route 7 and the Merritt Parkway. Just minutes to South Norwalk (SoNo), with top-rated restaurants, shopping and waterfront attractions. First building on the right upon entry-come take a look!
